task.title: Standardize health endpoints for optional channel services
task.summary_zh: 把 optional channel services 的 health surface 補齊到 repo 標準；至少 services/channels/web 要有 /healthz /livez /readyz，保留 /health alias，且不把 channel 納入 default compose。
acceptance: Web channel exposes /healthz /livez /readyz with canonical health payload and keeps /health compatibility
Readiness reports router dependency as ok degraded or unavailable without crashing
Tests cover all standard health endpoints and legacy /health
No default compose inclusion or BFF HA topology work is introduced
Optional bot channel limitations are documented or explicitly scoped out if they have no HTTP process
task.next: Checkpoint: finalized optional web channel health standard after Claude approval; commit 546e58a2828c3ae42f2ba4e7a74985dbf65509b4 records /healthz /livez /readyz /health alias, readiness degradation tests, optional-channel scope docs, and review evidence. Verification: python3 -m pytest services/channels/web/test_main.py services/channels/test_web_health.py -q (9 passed); python3 -m pytest services/foundation/tests/test_health.py -q (5 passed).
review_notes_zh: 審閱通過：web channel 已實作 /healthz /livez /readyz /health alias 與 /metrics；router 依賴以 ok/degraded/unavailable 三態回報，含 404 fallback 至 /health legacy probe；tests 涵蓋全部 endpoints 及三種 readiness degradation 路徑；docker-compose.yml 無 web-channel 預設條目，test 強制驗證；services/channels/README.md 明確說明 Telegram/Discord 不開 HTTP process，bot channel scope 通過 test 約束。14 個 tests 全數通過。

handoffs.message: Implemented web channel canonical health endpoints (/healthz /livez /readyz /metrics plus /health alias), router readiness ok/degraded/unavailable handling, tests, and optional bot channel scope README. Verification: python3 -m pytest services/channels/web/test_main.py services/channels/test_web_health.py -q; python3 -m pytest services/foundation/tests/test_health.py -q.
Review approved. All acceptance criteria met; 14 tests pass. Returning to owner (Codex) for finalization.
